# DreamLand MUD

> DreamLand is a free text-based multiplayer fantasy game (a MUD) running since 1998. It is dark, funny and a little postmodern. It plays in a web browser or any telnet client, it is playable in English, Ukrainian and Russian, and it is built to work with screen readers: about 30% of its players are blind.

Play in the browser at https://dreamland.rocks/play/ or connect a telnet client to dreamland.rocks port 9000. Free to play, nothing sold gives power. Forked from Anatolia MUD (DikuMUD / Merc / ROM lineage), started in Ukraine and still run by Ukrainian developers. The engine and the clients are open source; game scripts and area files are not.

The world: 158 areas, about 9,800 rooms, 3,700 creatures and 5,700 objects. 13 classes, 23 playable races, 22 gods and 22 cults, 11 hometowns, 10 clans (8 with their own skills). Blacksmith, carpenter, jeweler and tattooist trades with forges and mining. 56 hand-built area quests plus automatic personal quests. Randomly generated weapons, a gear advisor NPC, remort after level 100 with hero gear kept. Restricted PK, roleplay encouraged, newbie friendly. Adult content: 18+.

How it is built: most spells, skills, quests and NPC behaviour run on Fenia, the game's own scripting language, so builders change the live world without a reboot. Every player picks English, Ukrainian or Russian at login, and 99.7% of room descriptions exist in all three. Screen-reader mode (`config screenreader on`) replaces every visual element with linear text. The web client has a live graph map with click-to-walk, side panels and a phone layout. No LLM runs in the game: "AI" here means mob behaviour and combat AI.

The pages below marked "app" render in the browser from JSON, so a plain fetch gets an empty shell. Every help article and every news note also has a plain HTML page of its own, one per language, under the static indexes listed below.

Agents can read the help directly: https://dreamland.rocks/mcp/help is a public read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth) with `help_search`, `help_get`, `help_categories` and `help_list`, plus `item_search` (armor, weapons, magic items and pets with stats and where they come from, as on the searcher page), `who` (who is playing now) and `news_list`/`news_get` (the game news), in English, Ukrainian or Russian.

The main pages have an EN / UA / RU language toggle; there is no separate Russian site any more.

## Pages

- [Play](https://dreamland.rocks/play/): web client
- [Home](https://dreamland.rocks/): what the game is, latest news
- [What is DreamLand?](https://dreamland.rocks/about.html): how to play, the world in numbers, languages, accessibility, history, FAQ
- [Help in English](https://dreamland.rocks/en/help/): every translated help article as plain HTML, one page each (/en/help/<id>.html)
- [Help in Ukrainian](https://dreamland.rocks/ua/help/): the same in Ukrainian (/ua/help/<id>.html)
- [Help in Russian](https://dreamland.rocks/help/): every help article in Russian, the original language (/help/<id>.html)
- [Help](https://dreamland.rocks/help.html): app; search and filters over the same articles in all three languages
- [Help MCP server](https://dreamland.rocks/mcp/help): for AI agents; search and read every help article in three languages
- [Maps](https://dreamland.rocks/maps.html): app; every area with level ranges and maps
- [News](https://dreamland.rocks/news.html): app; in-game changelog
- [News in English](https://dreamland.rocks/en/news/): notes written in English or translated, one page each, newest first
- [News in Ukrainian](https://dreamland.rocks/ua/news/): notes written in Ukrainian (most news since 2024)
- [News in Russian](https://dreamland.rocks/ru/news/): notes written in Russian (the archive back to 2001)
- [Item search](https://dreamland.rocks/searcher.html): app; weapons, armor and magic items by stats
- [Our values](https://dreamland.rocks/values.html): why DreamLand stands with Ukraine, and the respect the game runs on
- [Legends](https://dreamland.rocks/legends.html): stories, samurai tales and Second Epoch legends written by players; in Russian
- [Gallery](https://dreamland.rocks/gallery.html): player videos, character drawings and sample descriptions; in Russian

## Community

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/Ds46EpdKaF): players and developers
- [Telegram](https://t.me/dreamland_rocks): ask players and staff
- [GitHub](https://github.com/dreamland-mud): engine, web client, website
- [Email](mailto:dreamland.mud@gmail.com)

## Optional

- [Fenia API](https://dreamland.rocks/feniaapi.html): fields, methods and flag tables of the game's scripting language, generated by the running server; in Russian
- Static area maps at https://dreamland.rocks/maps/<area>.html: one ASCII map page per area, in Russian
